Releases

This variable runs over 2 spans of releases. Within a span the links say the meaning stayed the same; between spans, a link says what changed. The record above is 2022-2023's.

2017-2019: MARSTAT 2017-2019

AD-7b R's marital status

Now I'd like to ask about marital status and living together. Please look at Card 1. What is your current marital or cohabiting status?

Codes: 1 Married to a person of the opposite sex; 2 Not married but living together with a partner of the opposite sex; 3 Widowed; 4 Divorced or annulled; 5 Separated, because you and your spouse are not getting along; 6 Never been married; 8 Refused; 9 Don't know

Changed from 2017-2019 (MARSTAT) to 2022-2023 (MARSTAT): wording_changed, codes_changed publisher:nsfg-2022-2023-quex-changes

wording_changed is what the summary states. codes_changed is from the two codebooks: 1-6 (married, cohabiting, widowed, divorced, separated, never married) in 2017-2019; 1-3 (married, living together, neither) in 2022-2023.

2022-2023: MARSTAT 2022-2023 (current)
